insurance_intermediary_role.label: Insurance intermediary role
insurance_intermediary_role.value: Independent online and phone-based health insurance broker and marketplace, mainly for Medicare plans

insurance_placement_niche.label: Insurance placement niche
insurance_placement_niche.value: Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement and Part D plans for seniors, plus some individual and family and small-business health plans

intermediary_compensation.label: Intermediary compensation
intermediary_compensation.value: Carrier-paid commissions on enrollments and renewals, plus marketing and other fees from carriers

carrier_market_access.label: Carrier / market access
carrier_market_access.value: Multiple carrier relationships, offering plans from many national and regional health insurers

notes: The website evidence was an error page, so these answers come from general knowledge of eHealth, not the evidence.
